scope: These are records actually read, including source code and evaluated results; this is not a claim that keyword absence alone proves novelty.

family_comparison.tube_dispersion: 3/3 plain and3/3 hinted. Prior code has only bare 2Dt variance, discarding every flow history. Here nonzero full shear enhancement is exact and calibrated; missing microscopic feedback and streamline geometry is different.
family_comparison.driven_diffusion: 3/3 plain and3/3 hinted. It misapplies equilibrium mobility-diffusion response in a driven potential. Current task has incompressible advection and no force-response readout.
family_comparison.survivor_transport: 2/3 plain. Earlier endpoint-versus-path conditioning is absent here; every tracer survives and is counted.
family_comparison.actuator_frame_current: Related stochastic sampling background, but current source does not eliminate inertial/colored forces or choose noise basis. No singular microscopic limit is used.
family_comparison.single_file_memory: Temporal closure background shared, but current setup has independent tracers, no fixed lattice or exclusion and no two-time covariance readout.

primary_sources.title: Majda and Kramer, Simplified models for turbulent diffusion, Physics Reports314 (1999)
primary_sources.access: Institutional-mirror full PDF accessible. Read sections2.1 and2.2.3, especially cell-problem formulas and shear/cellular scaling; finite-time discussion also read. Did not read the entire337-page paper.
primary_sources.scope: Supports periodic-flow homogenization, role of Lagrangian sampling and cellular topology. The particular self-consistent surrogate is independently constructed here, not claimed to be a formula established as exact by this source.

primary_sources.title: Phythian and Curtis, The effective long-time diffusivity for a passive scalar in a Gaussian model fluid flow
primary_sources.access: Publisher abstract/search result read, not full paper.
primary_sources.scope: Only background that self-consistent Gaussian flow approximations exist; its random velocity field is not the deterministic periodic apparatus here.
